Hi Samir / Aisha,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for customer support routing + response generation.
- Key success metrics: P95 latency < 300ms, cost per 1M tokens under target, and predictable SLA for peak hours.
- Stakeholders likely to attend: Samir (product), Aisha (ops), Priya (CTO) — please confirm.

Next step: 30-min intro demo to walk through Redwood’s runtime, dashboard, and a high-level technical fit. I can run a concise demo + leave 10 minutes for Q&A. Can you confirm one of these options? All times in PST: 

1) Mon, Mar 11 — 1:00 PM PT (30 min)
2) Tue, Mar 12 — 10:00 AM PT (30 min)
3) Wed, Mar 13 — 4:00 PM PT (30 min)

If none of these work, tell me a couple good windows and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a suggested 1-page agenda for the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,

Marissa Cole
